meta.title: Catch And Tame items data
meta.notes: The standalone Catch and Tame items page lists food, bait, mutation consumables, the Mutation Diffuser, Lucky Blocks, and Weather Totems. Fandom Shop is used only as a category cross-check for food and buildings. Specific active code names from the source page are intentionally not stored in this durable catalog dataset.

items.name: Steak
items.cardSummary: Feeds one animal and increases its weight, which raises its BPS output.
items.source: Redeem codes, daily login rewards, Lucky Blocks, Food Stand, and Traveling Merchant
items.bestUse: Spend on animals with the best base BPS before feeding low-value catches.
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki row; Fandom Shop category cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local item image not collected

items.name: Bone
items.cardSummary: Placed on the ground to lure Wolves in the Forest biome.
items.source: Redeem codes, Lucky Blocks, Food Stand, and daily login rewards
items.bestUse: Carry a stack when farming Forest Wolf or regular Wolf routes.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local item image not collected

items.name: Prime Feed
items.cardSummary: A stronger feed item that gives more weight and BPS than regular Steak.
items.source: Lucky Blocks, Traveling Merchant, and event rewards
items.bestUse: Save for pets with long-term pen value instead of early common animals.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local item image not collected

items.name: Enriched Feed
items.cardSummary: The highest listed food tier for a single weight and BPS boost.
items.source: Lucky Blocks, Traveling Merchant, and high-tier event rewards
items.bestUse: Hold for your strongest keeper pets because supply is limited.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local item image not collected

items.name: Bloodmoon Grape
items.cardSummary: Fed to a pet during Bloodmoon progression for a chance at the Bloodbound mutation.
items.source: Bloodmoon weather map spawns, Bloodmoon Spin Wheel, and Bloodmoon Lucky Blocks
items.bestUse: Use on a pet with strong base BPS so the mutation multiplier matters.
items.chance: Bloodbound is listed as a 2.5x mutation
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki row; mutation value cross-checks with local mutations dataset
items.imageStatus: local cropped row image from Fandom Bloodmoon Grapes file

items.name: Cosmic Fruit
items.cardSummary: Collected at meteor impact sites during Cosmic Shower weather and fed to pets for the Cosmic route.
items.source: Meteor impact sites during Cosmic Shower and rare Lucky Block drops
items.bestUse: Collect quickly during the weather window before impact-site rewards disappear.
items.chance: Cosmic is listed as a 1.5x mutation
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki row; weather and mutation cross-check
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local item image not collected

items.name: Chocolate Heart
items.cardSummary: A Valentine's event consumable that feeds into the Lovestruck mutation route.
items.source: Valentine's weather event map spawns and event reward routes
items.bestUse: Use during the event on pets that are valuable enough to keep after the event ends.
items.chance: Lovestruck is listed as a 2.25x mutation
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local item image not collected

items.name: Mutation Diffuser
items.cardSummary: A placed machine that removes a selected unwanted mutation from a pet.
items.source: Buildings section of the Lassos and Food Shop
items.bestUse: Clear a low-value mutation only when you have a better mutation route ready.
items.sourceStatus: Standalone wiki row; Fandom Shop confirms buildings category
items.imageStatus: local row image from Fandom Mutation Diffuser file

items.name: Standard Lucky Block
items.cardSummary: A general reward block with food, early totems, coins, and low-rarity pet rewards in its listed pool.
items.source: Volcanic-mutated pen pets, daily login rewards, and Traveling Merchant
items.bestUse: Save for a strong luck window when you are chasing totems or better bulk rewards.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local block image not collected

items.name: Bloodmoon Lucky Block
items.cardSummary: A Bloodmoon reward block with Bloodmoon consumables, pets, cosmetics, coins, and food in its listed pool.
items.source: Bloodmoon Spin Wheel and Boss Hydra defeat rewards
items.bestUse: Open when you need Bloodmoon-route rewards, but do not spend weather luck boosts expecting this pool to improve.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local block image not collected

items.name: Legendary Lucky Block
items.cardSummary: A higher-tier reward block with rare food, rare totems, better pets, coins, and a rare lasso reward in its listed pool.
items.source: Volcanic-mutated pets and high-tier event completion
items.bestUse: Hold for a major luck window unless you urgently need feed or totems.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local block image not collected

items.name: Rain Totem
items.cardSummary: Triggers Rainy Weather for early luck and rain-route farming.
items.source: Lucky Blocks, daily login rewards, and Exclusive Shop
items.bestUse: Useful early when you want an easier weather window without spending rarer totems.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local totem image not collected

items.name: Thunderstorm Totem
items.cardSummary: Triggers Thunderstorm Weather for Charged mutation attempts and Lightning Dragon farming.
items.source: Lucky Blocks, daily login rewards, and Exclusive Shop
items.bestUse: Use when you can watch Dragon Island and have pen pets worth upgrading.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local totem image not collected

items.name: Sandstorm Totem
items.cardSummary: Triggers Sandstorm Weather for desert-route rare spawns.
items.bestUse: Save for a focused desert farming route instead of using during normal catch loops.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local totem image not collected

items.name: Cosmic Totem
items.cardSummary: Triggers Cosmic Shower Weather for Cosmic mutation and Cosmic Griffin routes.
items.source: Legendary Lucky Blocks and Exclusive Shop
items.bestUse: Use when your pen and Sky Island route are both ready for the short weather window.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local totem image not collected

items.name: Aurora Totem
items.cardSummary: Triggers Aurora Borealis Weather for a large luck boost.
items.source: Legendary Lucky Blocks and Exclusive Shop
items.bestUse: Save for serious hatching, catching, or reward-opening sessions.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local totem image not collected

items.name: Blizzard Totem
items.cardSummary: Triggers Blizzard Weather for Snow Biome farming.
items.source: Lucky Blocks, daily login rewards, and Exclusive Shop
items.bestUse: Use when you are ready to farm snow-route pets during the weather window.
items.imageStatus: text-only; clean local totem image not collected
